process: Send square footage, photos and project location
pricing_note: Ranges are material-only planning ranges. They do not include tax, delivery, trim, transitions, underlayment, adhesives, demolition, subfloor preparation, stairs or installation. Final product specs and project scope must be verified.

specs.LVP: Typical 4–8mm thickness, 8–20 mil wear layer, click-lock or glue-down, commonly SPC/WPC core.
specs.Laminate: Typical 7–12mm thickness, commonly AC3–AC5 surface rating, floating click-lock, HDF core.
specs.Engineered Wood: Typical 3/8–3/4 inch total thickness, 1–4mm+ real wood veneer, plywood/composite core.
specs.Solid Hardwood: Commonly 3/4 inch solid wood plank, nail/staple installation, often refinishable multiple times.
specs.Carpet: Common fibers include polyester, nylon and triexta; carpet cushion/pad is a separate material decision.
specs.Tile: Ceramic, porcelain and stone options; finished assembly includes tile, thinset, support/membrane and subfloor.
